description_en: Queries the list of data sources for a parser
description_zh: 查询解析器数据源列表
name: ListParserDataSource

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，默认值为10，最大值不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: A string contained in the data source name. The system performs a fuzzy match based on this string to retrieve matching data source names
parameters.help_zh: 传入数据源名称中任意字符串，根据该字符串检索能匹配的数据源名称
parameters.name: search_name

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，默认值为1，取值范围为1~100
parameters.name: page

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

DataSource.description_en: The list of data sources returned
DataSource.description_zh: 返回的数据源列表信息

Description.description_en: The description of the data source

UtcCreated.description_en: The UTC time when the data source was created. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'` format

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

Page.description_en: The page number of the returned results
Page.description_zh: 显示返回结果中的第几页

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page in the returned results
PageSize.description_zh: 回结果中每页显示的记录数量

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败

Total.description_en: The total number of records returned
